findings.description: Missing CSP allows a broader range of injection attacks (XSS, data injection) to succeed unmitigated.
Missing X-Frame-Options allows the site to be embedded in an iframe, enabling clickjacking attacks.
Missing HSTS allows the site to be accessed over unencrypted HTTP, exposing traffic to interception.
Missing X-Content-Type-Options allows browsers to MIME-sniff responses, which can lead to content-type confusion issues.
Missing Referrer-Policy may leak full URLs to third-party sites via the Referer header.
Missing Permissions-Policy leaves browser feature access (camera, geolocation, etc.) unrestricted.
The 'Server' header discloses 'Heroku', which can help an attacker identify known vulnerabilities for that specific software/version.
